dedupe_keys.name: economic lifetime aware wind farm control

description: Anand, Abhinav and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The optimisation balances energy capture at varying market prices against maintenance costs, downtime and fatigue constraints. Turbine damage states may come from operational estimates or a digital twin; a twin implementation is not required or claimed by this record. Two evaluated examples include a simplified synthetic scenario and a small farm with meteorological-mast climate data. The source compares lifetime-aware policies with greedy and power-maximizing alternatives, with benefits conditional on its economic and fatigue assumptions. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The controller is based on the combination of economic valuation with component-lifetime budgets.
